sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Smt. Munni Devi And 2 Others
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 2 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Lalit Kumar Srivastava,Vijay Kumar Tiwari
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Salil Kumar Rai,J.
Hon'ble Sandeep Jain,J.
1. Heard the counsel for the petitioners and the A.G.A. for the State-respondents.

2. The present petition has been filed challenging the first information report dated 27.06.2025
registered as Case Crime No. 198 of 2025, Under Section 376 I.P.C., Police Station- Karchhana,
District- Prayagraj.

Smt. Munni Devi And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And 2 Others on 10 July, 2025
Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197154568/
1

3.

The perusal of the first information report discloses commission of cognizable offence involving the petitioners in the above case, therefore, it is not a case for quashing the first information report.

4. In view of the aforesaid, the writ petition stands dismissed.
